proof_body:
by
  intro a b c p q r hr
  have hN : 0 ≤ a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := by positivity
  constructor
  · intro h
    by_cases h0 : a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 = 0
    · have := h p q (by simp; positivity)
      rw [h0]; simpa using this
    · have hpos : 0 < a ^ 2 + b ^ 2 := lt_of_le_of_ne hN (Ne.symm h0)
      have hS : 0 < Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := Real.sqrt_pos.mpr hpos
      have hSq := Real.sq_sqrt hN
      have := h (p + r * a / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) (q + r * b / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) (by
        apply le_of_eq
        field_simp
        rw [hSq]; ring)
      have e : a * (p + r * a / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) + b * (q + r * b / Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) = a * p + b * q + r * Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) := by
        field_simp
        linear_combination (-r) * hSq
      linarith
  · intro h x y hd
    have hsq : (a * (x - p) + b * (y - q)) ^ 2 ≤ (r * Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2)) ^ 2 := by
      rw [mul_pow, Real.sq_sqrt hN]
      linarith [sq_nonneg (a * (y - q) - b * (x - p)), mul_le_mul_of_nonneg_right hd hN]
    have := (abs_le_of_sq_le_sq' hsq (by positivity)).2
    linarith
target_source: ∀ (a b c p q r : ℝ), 0 ≤ r → ((∀ x y : ℝ, (x - p) ^ 2 + (y - q) ^ 2 ≤ r ^ 2 → a * x + b * y ≤ c) ↔ a * p + b * q + r * Real.sqrt (a ^ 2 + b ^ 2) ≤ c)
